queries_run: Intuitive Surgical customer concentration risk disclosure 10-K no single customer 10% revenue
Intuitive Surgical credit rating OR downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：美國本土營收占 68%（2024 為 67%、2023 為 66%），海外 32%；銷售以直銷為主，客戶為各地醫院，10-K 此節未列單一大客戶占比
findings.excerpt: During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, domestic revenue accounted for 68%, 67%, and 66%, respectively, of total revenue, while revenue from our OUS markets accounted for 32%, 33%, and 34%, respectively, of total revenue.

findings.claim: 2026 年檢索未見信評機構調降 ISRG 信評；2026 年 7 月財報後的負面訊息來自 da Vinci 手術量成長指引與分析師目標價下調，而非客戶信用事件
findings.source: Tradingpedia / 搜尋摘要（2026-07-17 報導）
findings.excerpt: Intuitive Surgical reaffirmed its full-year 2026 outlook for da Vinci procedure growth at 13.5%-15.5% and indicated expectations closer to the midpoint of that range.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋僅取得舊年度 10-K 的『無單一客戶超過 10% 營收』摘要（FY2018 版），未取得 FY2025 逐字原文，故未列入 finding；客戶為分散的醫院。
